title: nixos/sanoid: add missing sanoid options regarding script hooks.
reason: Applicable: real sanoid module + wired test. Real diff adds 6 genuinely new mkOptions (pre_snapshot_script, post_snapshot_script, pruning_script, no_inconsistent_snapshot, force_post_snapshot_script, script_timeout) inside a shared commonOptions attrset spliced into both datasets.<name> and templates.<name> wildcard submodules.

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: 4th instance of the wastebin-class candidate_capability_gap (tally: wastebin/B3, paretosecurity/B6, this one, keycloak/this same batch). discovered_options is COMPLETELY EMPTY for this file (len=0). Confirmed the cause is the same dotted-path idiom: sanoid.nix declares its own top-level options via `options.services.sanoid = {...};` (line 175), exactly matching wastebin/paretosecurity's own pattern -- not a different root cause from the commonOptions-splicing shape I initially suspected; the total blackout is explained fully by the dotted-path idiom alone.
